title: Check wg beads against editors' copies
description: For every open wg bead, check the current editor's copy (main branch of the draft's GitHub repo; read-only clone into ~/GIT) and the latest published revision. Close beads already fixed (reason cites commit/revision); annotate the rest with the editor's-copy text. Then file one drafting task per document that still has open items (decompose just in time).
